brand.name: AUX
brand.notes: AUX AC (Guangdong AUX Group / AUX Electric, China). PK sales presence: United Group of Industries (Lahore) consortium + retail SKUs AXW-12/18PG/PW, Q-Series — but no auxair.com/pk and no PK-local error content. Primary sources: official AUX global error-codes page (25, high) + 2021 Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand PDF (Macroclima/AUX mirror: wall-floor 27, outdoor 3-LED 24, Category-L 12, portable 5 — all high). Product-line scoped: official global list vs 2021 wall/floor vs portable vs outdoor LED vs L-category kept in separate series files — E1/E3/E8/F6/H1/H4 meanings differ per line, never merged. AUX OEM claim unverified — shared Chinese OEM controllers do not make other brands' codes brand-safe (hard rule). Quarantines: Gree/Midea/Haier tables, non-AC AUX, other-brand SERP contamination.
